description_en: Adds tags to multiple Anti-DDoS Proxy instances at a time
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo create-tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type INSTANCE --resource-ids ddoscoo-cn-mp91j1ao0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTagResources

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the resource to which the tag belongs. Set the value to INSTANCE, which indicates an Anti-DDoS Pro instance
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型。取值固定为INSTANCE，表示DDoS高防实例
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Proxy instances to which you want to add tags
parameters.help_zh: 要绑定标签的DDoS高防实例的ID列表
parameters.name: resource_ids

fields.help_en: The key of the tag to add
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the tag to add
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: An array that consists of the tags to add
parameters.name: tags
